title: MIACE and Monotone Tracking: Exact Tuning for First-Order Plants and Positive Cascades with Pure Delay
summary: The Module of Integral Absolute Complex Error (MIACE) was created by me 23 years ago. It gave very nice behaviour to the transient response of the controlled systems I tested. It combines absolute tracking-error and equilibrium-centered command areas. For a stable unit-gain plant with known pure delay, an exact identity separates squared MIACE excess into a negative-area penalty and a weighted area imbalance.
